value.note: When you cast avatar with your Supreme Incarnation slot and this is your primary attuned apparition, you do not become an avatar of a deity; the apparition incarnates itself using your body, transforming you into its avatar: **Cosmic Notary** Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; **Melee** ⟨1⟩ burning pen (agile, reach 15 feet, versatile fire), **Damage** 6d6+6 piercing; **Ranged** ⟨1⟩ exacting language (fatal d10, mental, range 60 feet), **Damage** 6d6+6 mental

backfillRows.why: AoN apparition-16 prints "Avatar Cosmic Notary Speed 30 feet, fly 50 feet; Melee Single Action burning pen (agile, reach 15 feet, versatile fire), Damage 6d6+6 piercing; Ranged Single Action exacting language (fatal d10, mental, range 60 feet), Damage 6d6+6 mental", and AoN class-feature-1056 (Supreme Incarnation) prints "When you cast avatar in this way, you do not become an avatar of a deity; rather, your primary attuned apparition incarnates itself using your body, transforming you into the avatar described in your primary attuned apparition's entry." The form reached the player only as prose on the apparition; the N2 spellNotes pass (build.ts ownedRecords, classFeatureIdsOwned carries the attuned apparition) now writes it onto the Avatar spell's detail under the apparition's name. That pass has no primary-apparition gate, so the note states the primary condition itself.

findings.note: New field on the record (no existing overlay row for classFeatures/lamentation-of-sinister-deals spellNotes; its record has no spellNotes today). Reuses the existing SpellNote lane ({spellId, note}), rendered by SpellsTab through DescBody, so the ⟨1⟩ action glyphs and **bold** match the apparition's own description copy. The other 13 apparitions have the same gap (b034 monarch-of-the-fey-courts#avatar) but are not findings of this batch.

backfillRows.why: AoN background-654 prints "You're trained in the Religion skill, and the Azlant Lore skill ." The record carried only trainedSkill 'religion'; trainedLore is read by build.ts (the background trainedLore loop, through loreKey) and trains lore:azlant, the same subject slug scholar-of-the-ancients uses.

findings.note: Single top-level scalar field, absent today, no existing overlay row for this key. The Azlanti language half is azlanti-researcher#language (engine family, grantsLanguages) - a different field, so no collision.

Precedent nomadic-halfling.
